falsification_conditions.condition: The price closes above the 200-day moving average by at least 3%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a strong bullish trend contradicting the 'HOLD' signal, suggesting the pattern is not a topping formation but a breakout.

falsification_conditions.condition: Volume surges to 200% above the 30-day average on two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such extreme volume would invalidate the 'HOLD' by demonstrating clear market conviction contrary to the pattern's implied indecision.

falsification_conditions.condition: A major central bank announces a 50-basis-point rate cut within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This macro event would directly contradict the pattern's implied context, rendering the current verdict based on historical pattern matching obsolete.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
